text:
sara: Hey — hitting a weird onboarding block. New customer ran quickstart and gets a 401 on the very first /v1/chat call. Console shows workspace in "Billing consent required" state. Can anyone confirm if that should be a 401 or 402?

sara: Their curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hello"}'
```

sara: Response: 401 + body {"error":"unauthorized","reason":"org.billing_consent_required"} and no HTML console link in the body. UX confusing for the customer.

tom: 401 is what the auth layer returns when org-level controls block tokens. Historically we returned 402-like for payment issues, but org consent was a newer flow. 401 is expected right now, but we should make the error friendlier.

nilesh: Also saw this when a workspace was created via SSO invite. The console has a banner that owner must accept billing terms. If they haven't, auth service attaches header `X-Org-Auth-Note: billing_consent_required`.

sara: interesting — they said they accepted something in the UI though. Could be a timing race. They used the node quickstart which retries on 401 currently. That causes the app to appear flaky (first call 401, retry 401, gives up).

alexa: Can you paste the SDK trace? Node has a TRACE env that prints raw responses. If the header `WWW-Authenticate: Billing consent required` is present then we can map to a nicer message.

sara: trace snippet (redacted):
```
> Request POST /v1/chat
< 401 Unauthorized
< WWW-Authenticate: org.billing_consent_required
< Content-Type: application/json
< {"error":"unauthorized","reason":"org.billing_consent_required"}
```

devex-bot: Related runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding-runbook — section "billing gating vs token auth". Suggests sending users to workspace settings -> Accept billing terms.

nilesh: Root cause we saw earlier: token validation runs before org-affinity check, so SDK sees 401 as transient and retries. But this 401 is terminal until owner accepts. We should special-case 401 when `WWW-Authenticate` or `reason` indicates billing_consent_required and avoid retrying.

ops_oncall: Workaround for now: ask customer to open workspace settings -> Billing -> Accept terms (owner/admin). If they can't, create a temporary sandbox workspace and move testing there. I'll open a support ticket and attach logs.

tom: Filed internal ticket (#INT-4821) to update Node/Python SDKs to treat this particular 401 as non-retriable and to bubble up a clearer error message with a console link. Also adding a tiny UX change to include a help_url in the API body for this reason.

alexa: Can we also add a short message in the hosted API response: "message":"Workspace requires owner billing consent. Visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing"? That would dramatically reduce confusion.

sara: Perfect. Customer is unblocked after owner accepted billing via console. Leaving notes for support: 1) If 401 + reason org.billing_consent_required -> do not trigger SDK retry. 2) Surface console link in message. 3) Add a doc snippet to quickstart about workspace billing/acceptance.

nilesh: I'll cut the SDK PR today (node: #5482, python follow-up). ETA rolling to prod in ~48h.

devex-bot: Tagging: @devex oncall, @sdk-team.

sara: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

tom: Nice find — leaving the ticket with you, @nilesh. :+1:
